state.description: standby: the quiet ambient screen (nobody here). alert: an alert with no other state. A wake is never a state: it is the change to listening, with last_wake

level.description: Voice or TTS level for listening/speaking

countdown_s.description: Seconds left in the answer window (waiting)

message.description: What to do next when offline or there is a problem

alert.description: An alert on top of any state: the ring turns amber (warn) or red (crit) with one pulse

last_wake.description: On a wake (listening): when he woke Jarvis the time before, or null for the first wake. The first wake of the day, or one after 4 hours away, gets the full wake beat; every other wake the short one
